skills.name: 谋诛
skills.text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以令一名其他角色交给你一张手牌，若其手牌数小于你，其视为对你使用一张【杀】或【决斗】。

skills.name: 延祸
skills.text: 当你死亡时，你可以弃置杀死你的角色至多X张牌（X为你的牌数）。

supplementaryEvidence.level: Same-product community reference, checked 2026-10-16; edited 2025-06-01. Not the primary text authority.
supplementaryEvidence.supports: The classic OL entry explicitly assigns the post-gift Slash/Duel choice to the donor. Its separate 1V1 entry has different Yanhuo wording and is not used.

supplementaryEvidence.level: Historical OL channel terminology, indexed passage checked 2026-10-16; direct page request timed out. General vocabulary only, not a current He Jin FAQ.
supplementaryEvidence.supports: The ownership entry assigns a player ownership of Hand and Equipment, while Judgment cards have no player owner.

supplementaryEvidence.level: Archived official rulebook 3.0 transcription; general use-condition background, predates this OL edition.
supplementaryEvidence.supports: Ordinary Slash quota is a condition of free Play declarations. Target legality and distance remain separate conditions.

supplementaryEvidence.level: Archived official rulebook 3.0 transcription; general card-operation background.
supplementaryEvidence.supports: The performer of discarding another player's cards chooses them. A single multi-card discard is one operation, rather than repeated selections after triggered gains.

interpretations.basis: Primary instruction order plus payable target legality; no current OL FAQ on empty-hand targets was located.
interpretations.implementation: The other living target must have a hand card to give. The donor privately chooses the actual hand entity. After the native transfer and its child windows, compare the two actual hands. A tie or greater donor hand ends the skill.

interpretations.basis: The same-product classic entry explicitly assigns the choice to the donor. Distance/quota details are general-rule inferences, not claims of a current specific FAQ.
interpretations.implementation: The donor chooses among currently legal native Slash and Duel. No physical card is paid. Effect-driven use does not spend ordinary free-Play Slash quota; absent an explicit exception, current distance and use/target prohibitions apply. Native response, nullification, damage, dying and death resolve normally.

interpretations.basis: Primary says your cards; historical OL ownership terminology separates owned HE from unowned Judgment. The engine opens OwnerDied after cleanup, so the exact precleanup DeathFrame freezes the owned HE entities.
interpretations.implementation: Capture Hand and Equipment on the native DeathFrame before cleanup; exclude Judgment, processing cards and skill piles. Bind the actual killer from the same DeathFrame. No killer, a dead killer or no owned cards creates no discard operation.

interpretations.basis: Primary says up to X cards, contrasted with the separate 1V1 wording expressly saying sequentially.
interpretations.implementation: The dead He Jin privately seals zero through X killer Hand/Equipment cards before payment. Foreign hands publish opaque zone/slot choices; equipment is public. Confirm once, move the selected set natively, and drain genuine equipment-loss/recovery/movement/death children before the original death resumes. Newly gained cards cannot enter the selected operation.

runtime.pendingState: Immutable HeJinMouzhu/HeJinYanhuo receipt on its owning ProgramSkillFrame; predeath cards on its exact DeathFrame, never a mutable use-id sidecar.
runtime.nativeUse: Zero-entity CardUseFrame.HeJinMouzhu origin binds the actual donor and original paid program to native Slash/Duel and typed attack returns.
runtime.nativeDeath: Yanhuo freezes original DeathFrame, optional DyingFrame/DamageFrame, original attack and death-window candidate cursor. Only that original dead dying is suspended while genuine discard children run.
runtime.events: New rule facts use AdvanceEventRulesAndQueueFact. Private hand gift identity is absent from the added public payment fact. Collection-bearing receipts defensively copy into read-only collections.

verification: Root-owned new focused, related regression, and exact no-argument routine verification passed; see rootVerification.

info.biography: 东汉灵帝时大将军。何进的异母妹有宠于灵帝并被立为皇后，他也随之升迁。黄巾起义时，何进为大将军，总镇京师。灵帝驾崩后，蹇[jiǎn]硕谋诛进而立皇子刘协，未果，反被进诛。何进从袁绍之言，博征智谋之士为己所用，独揽大权。然而何进不纳陈琳之谏，多结外镇军阀，翘首京师，与袁绍等谋诛宦竖。终于事泄，被张让等先下手为强，遭杀身之祸。
info.characteristic: 每回合都能够获得敌人的牌使敌人变得脆弱。死亡时弃置敌人大量的牌使其变得脆弱。
